messages:
mira (prod): RCA published for this morning's serving regression. Short summary: an unexpected interaction between node-grace-period and warm-pool reclamation caused cascade fallbacks into smaller models for ~22m. Full RCA: https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/1812500000 (internal)
incident-bot: Postmortem available: https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/1812500000 :white_check_mark:
dan (oncall): Thanks — I took notes. I'll own Action-1 (tighten reclaim timer ordering and add locks). Plan: reproduce locally and push hotfix + unit test. ETA 2026-04-03.
sana (eng-runtime): I'll take Action-2 (validate model-variant routing + add end-to-end test). Also adding an alert for unexpected variant flapping. ETA 2026-03-29.
liam (sre): Mitigation deployed: raised warm-pool min count to avoid immediate reclaim cycles. I'll monitor metrics and roll back once fixes land. Posting runbook snippet shortly.
mira (prod): Consolidated action items in the doc:
```
Action-1: Fix reclaim ordering/locking 0 owner: @dan 0 ETA: 2026-04-03
Action-2: E2E model-variant routing tests + alert 0 owner: @sana 0 ETA: 2026-03-29
Action-3: Improve rollout gating & canary checks 0 owner: @liam 0 Checkpoint: 2026-03-28 09:30 PT
Action-4: Customer note & FAQ draft 0 owner: @mira 0 ETA: EOD today
```
mira (prod): Scheduling quick follow-up sync: 2026-03-28 09:30 PT (15m). If you can't make it, update the RCA doc.
jordan (ceo): Nice concise RCA. Please include an explicit line in the customer note about dedicated vs hosted capacity fallbacks. Keep execs posted after the canary. :thumbsup:
dan (oncall): For reproducibility: steps are in the RCA under "repro steps". I'll attach a short script to the PR.
sana (eng-runtime): Also adding metric `variant_flap_rate` and a dashboard. Will link before checkpoint.
liam (sre): Canaries will run with a stricter latency SLO and health threshold 99.8%. Will post canary results to this thread after checkpoint.
mira (prod): Drafted customer-facing note, tagged @support and @sales for review. ETA for final send: 2026-03-27 EOD.
incident-bot: RCA doc updated: 4 actions (3 open, 1 mitigated).
jordan (ceo): FYI to leadership: estimated customer impact <0.5% of requests. Root cause understood; fixes have owners and timelines.
liam (sre): Quick heads-up: if we see any flapping during the canary I'll abort and revert mitigation changes.
mira (prod): Thanks everyone. Closing this notif thread 00. Keep the RCA doc as the source of truth and tag me for blockers.
